observations.denominator: Total complaints received in 2024; not population incidence
observations.note: A higher complaint count may reflect awareness, access or demand; not automatically worse governance.

observations.denominator: Investigated complaints; not equivalent to complaints received or upheld

observations.population: Complaints dealt with by Ombudsman in 2024

observations.measure: Fully or partially upheld investigated complaints

observations.measure: Claimed pandemic unemployment payment recovery withdrawn after review
observations.denominator: One case, amount originally sought for recovery; not an aggregate
observations.note: Department determined entitlement and no liability to repay; not a criminal or disciplinary finding.

observations.measure: Carer's Allowance arrears granted after reconsideration
observations.denominator: One case; nine months of arrears
observations.note: Appeals office changed earlier decision after missed medical report identified; date is case publication, not payment date.

observations.denominator: Combined matters; not substantiated wrongdoing findings

events.subject: Department of Social Protection
events.finding: Ombudsman case study records disputed €26,000 recovery.
events.disposition: Department reviewed entitlement and withdrew recovery; underlying decision date unspecified.

events.subject: Social Welfare Appeals Office
events.finding: Ombudsman case study identified unconsidered medical assessment in appeal.
events.disposition: Appeals decision revised and nine months of arrears (€6,078) awarded; actual resolution date unspecified.

events.subject: Office of the Ombudsman
events.finding: 2024 report documented 4,778 complaints received and mixed case dispositions.
events.disposition: Publication is not a judgment about individual public officials.

events.subject: Office of the Ombudsman
events.disposition: Complaint intake is not adjudicated misconduct.

events.subject: New Zealand Office of the Ombudsman
events.finding: Annual release recorded 8,163 completed complaints and 104% clearance.
events.disposition: Case throughput is not evidence of citizen trust.

events.subject: New Zealand Ministry of Education
events.finding: Ombudsman announced investigation into allegations of attempts to circumvent the Official Information Act.
events.disposition: Allegations not established; no final findings in cited announcement.

events.subject: New Zealand Ministry of Education Curriculum Centre
events.finding: Ombudsman formally notified Ministry of investigation of recordkeeping and OIA/Public Records Act compliance.
events.disposition: Inquiry ongoing as of this notice; do not infer wrongdoing or outcome.

events.subject: US Government Accountability Office
events.finding: GAO documented June 2023 and June 2024 passport help-line wait-time differences.
events.disposition: Service audit does not determine political trust or individual misconduct.

methodology.denominatorGuardrail: Complaints, completed cases, investigations, upheld subset, people, calls and survey respondents are different denominators; 104% clearance is throughput not incidence.
methodology.statusGuardrail: NZ Ministry of Education inquiry is pending allegations; Irish administrative reversals are not criminal convictions; audits are not individual guilt.
methodology.dateGuardrail: Irish 2024 case studies have publication dates, not established case resolution dates; FY and calendar years distinct.
methodology.precisionGuardrail: GAO less-than-one-minute observation encoded as strict upper bound; approximate counts never converted to exact.
methodology.modelGuardrail: No cross-country ranking, causal inference or linkage to political trust.
methodology.productionGuardrail: No modifications to redistricting feed, APIs or production UX.
